description: Full-width responsive dashboard web part supporting tabs, accordions, and custom cards/embeds for SharePoint Online.
architecture: SPFx v1.23+ Heft Toolchain with React 17 and Microsoft Fluent UI 2 (@fluentui/react-components)

modules.name: FullWidthContainerWebPart
modules.role: Entrypoint SPFx WebPart class managing lifecycle, theme variants, property pane, and rendering React root.

modules.name: ThemeBridge
modules.role: Bridges SharePoint SPFx IReadonlyTheme / semanticColors to Fluent UI 2 Theme tokens for FluentProvider.

modules.name: FullWidthContainer
modules.role: Root React container component wrapping hierarchy in FluentProvider, handling layout switching, filtering, search, and user profile avatar diagnostics with Microsoft Graph properties.

modules.name: TabsContainer
modules.role: Fluent 2 TabList and Tab navigation view with active indicators and responsive card grid.

modules.name: AccordionContainer
modules.role: Fluent 2 Accordion, AccordionItem, and AccordionHeader collapsible layout with Expand/Collapse All toolbar.

modules.name: BlockRenderer
modules.role: Renders child content items using Fluent 2 Card, Badge, Button, and Key Metrics in GBP £.

modules.name: CardEditDialog
modules.role: In-place Fluent UI 2 Modal Dialog for editing card type, typography (font family, font colour, title/body font sizes), inner composable items (buttons, images, videos, CTAs), icon, badge, links, and British financial metrics on canvas.

modules.name: FloatingTextToolbar
modules.role: Floating contextual formatting ribbon modeled after the native SharePoint Text Web Part toolbar.

modules.name: InsertionBar
modules.role: Hover-activated (+) insertion bar for adding content items directly onto the canvas.

modules.name: ToolboxModal
modules.role: Content toolbox modal displaying Microsoft SharePoint authoring tools for insertion into cards.

modules.name: TermStorePicker
modules.role: SharePoint Global Term Store taxonomy browser and interactive Fluent UI 2 tag pill selector.

modules.name: FluentIconPicker
modules.role: Visual icon picker modal with instant keyword search, categories, and icon preview.

modules.name: RichTextEditable
modules.role: Inline WYSIWYG rich text editor with non-collapsing Floating Toolbar, site theme colors, brand fonts, and smart dual-mode formatting (selection vs whole block).

modules.name: LiveDataRenderer
modules.role: Dynamic real-time REST/Graph API text and metric renderer with connectivity status and refresh.

modules.name: TaxonomyService
modules.role: Service managing SharePoint Term Store taxonomy queries and metadata fallback terms.

modules.name: LiveDataService
modules.role: Service handling dynamic REST API execution, JSONPath extraction, and formatting.

modules.name: ContainerModels
modules.role: Type definitions for panels, tabs, items, layout configuration, and default UK datasets.

modules.name: DragIsolation
modules.role: Suppresses SharePoint Online native Canvas Move Web Part controller during card boundary resizing and rich text editing.

modules.name: BrandColorPickerPopover
modules.role: Fluent UI 2 visual popover colour picker with categorized Turner & Townsend brand palettes, contextual Default Option swatches with accurate colour representations, active selection rings, preview swatches, and custom hex input.

modules.name: DashboardStorageService
modules.role: SharePoint REST API storage service handling full dashboard package backups, versioned snapshots, cross-site portable JSON files, user prompt for library provisioning, automatic creation of Backups and Templates folders in the Dashboards library, and resilient root-library upload fallback.

modules.name: CustomSvgIconRegistry
modules.role: Pluggable registry and unified icon renderer for custom corporate SVG collections with dynamic color and background styling.

modules.name: PropertyPaneIconField
modules.role: Custom Property Pane field providing 24px icon preview with label and modal launcher for the full 229-icon collection.

modules.name: TtSvgIconCollection
modules.role: Full corporate collection of 224 Turner & Townsend SVG icons with automated currentColor stroke mapping and metadata.

modules.name: SectionEditDialog
modules.role: In-place Fluent UI 2 side panel for configuring section titles, badges, icons, glyph colors, icon containers, and section background colors.

modules.name: CardItemPropertyEditor
modules.role: Fluent UI 2 modal dialog providing tailored contextual property editing forms for all 14 card inner item types (including the new 'dropdown' filter type with reorderable options) with real-time live canvas syncing.

modules.name: TermFilterBar
modules.role: Fluent UI 2 component rendering configurable Global Term Store filter dropdowns, dynamic term population, and reactive selection summary pill with clear controls.

modules.name: TermFilterConfigDialog
modules.role: Fluent UI 2 in-place modal dialog for adding, configuring, and removing Global Term Store filter dropdowns in Edit Mode.

modules.name: FilterButtonsRenderer
modules.role: Interactive pill button filters with active state highlighting and card filtering dispatch.

modules.name: ProcessModelRenderer
modules.role: Customisable process stage chevron flow component with configurable step count, capability badges, and URL navigation / card filtering.

modules.name: ComposableContentSection
modules.role: Composable content area for top-of-webpart and top-of-section content authoring supporting all 16 inner item types (including 'dropdown' filter and 'capabilities' mini-cards), alignment controls, insertion bars, and inline editing.

modules.name: CapabilitiesRenderer
modules.role: Renders the capabilities content part: displays an editable section title with live count ('Capabilities applied here X'), styled mini-cards with title, subtitle, semantic tag badges, and action links.

modules.name: FilterDropdownsRenderer
modules.role: Renders a responsive horizontal row of multiple filter dropdowns with SharePoint Term Store resolution, multi-filter selection dispatch, active indicators, and 'Clear all' button.

recentChanges.description: Multi-Dropdown Filter Bar: added capability to add, reorder, and configure multiple filter dropdowns alongside each other in a horizontal row (like Filter Buttons). Supports per-dropdown Term Store term sets or custom options, live selection dispatching, active indicators, and 'Clear all'.
Search bar permanently relocated to headerTopRight. In edit mode a pencil icon opens a Fluent UI 2 Popover to edit the placeholder text, persisted via onSearchPlaceholderChange.

New 'dropdown' ICardItemType composable item. Renders as a Fluent UI 2 Dropdown dispatching dashboard:card-filter-apply. Editable via CardItemPropertyEditor and CardEditDialog (label, placeholder, term set name, reorderable static options). Filter-host protection extended in TabsContainer and AccordionContainer.

Author-only user profile diagnostics inspection icon in the edit banner next to 'Save snapshot to Library'. Clicking reveals a Fluent UI 2 popover listing active pageContext.user properties and values (displayName, email, loginName, guest flags) for instant debugging.

Process model property modal redesign: fixed clipped buttons by enforcing a pinned flexbox footer with sticky positioning and scrolling dialog content; added rich text editing micro-toolbar (bold, italic, list, eraser) for stage descriptions; introduced a segmented interactivity selector clearly separating 'Filter Cards' and 'Open Web Link' with helper callouts; humanised dialog title to 'Configure the process model'; and provided dedicated taxonomy group/term set picker for composable dropdown filters.

Capabilities Card Content Part: added 'capabilities' item type with dynamic count header ('Capabilities applied here X - [secondary label]'), responsive mini-cards layout, tag badge styling with Turner & Townsend semantic colors, and deep configuration options in CardItemPropertyEditor.
User Profile Graph attributes (jobTitle, officeLocation), isSiteAdmin detection, and dynamic user avatar photo with initials fallback.
Multi-Dropdown Filter Bar item allowing multiple reorderable dropdown filters positioned horizontally side-by-side with multi-token filtering.

Modal Dialogs and Panels Theme Hydration and Solid Surfaces: wraps all portaled trees in FluentProvider theme={webLightTheme} to hydrate Griffel tokens and enforces solid white surface backgrounds (#FFFFFF !important) across all property panels and modal dialogs.

Dynamic Filter Web Part (DynamicFilterWebPart): central SPFx Dynamic Data web part featuring greeting (Good morning/afternoon/evening), full-height profile inspection popover, search bar, active filter tags with Clear All, and user profile dynamic pre-filtering.
Content Section Toggle Layout: Segmented toggle presentation mode alongside Tabs and Accordion for multi-section content, working across any column width and full-width containers.

Dynamic Filter Greeting and Taxonomy Synonym Pre-Filtering: Popover Admin badge and elevation restoration, greeting message configuration with time-of-day toggle and FirstName append, individual property checkboxes with live user examples, Term Store synonym resolution to canonical Term Names, and simplified active filter chips display.

Dynamic Filter Term Store Explorer and Sticky Search Autocomplete: Collapsible hierarchical taxonomy tree in Term Store Explorer with 'Select term parent' bottom-right button; persistent Enter-key search filter chips that stick when input text is cleared; 2-char Term Store autocomplete suggestions resolving synonyms directly to canonical Term titles.

Scoped Group and Single-Call Term Set Hierarchy: Directly targets primary designated Term Group (48666d46-190a-4511-80e8-9e3c76faedf1) and queries all terms per set with expand=parent,children in a single request, eliminating all 404 HTTP requests on leaf terms.

Target Term Set getlegacychildren and Deep Synonym Resolution: Scoped queries to 'Our business' Term Set (930372f6-3b00-46f8-8e63-4b40edb8fd22) via REST v2.1 getlegacychildren, guarded recursive child calls by childrenCount > 0 to eliminate 404s, interactive multi-tier Term Store Explorer picker with parent/leaf node selection, and recursive deep synonym resolution traversing full descendant subtrees.

Multi-Tier Profile Photo Harvester: Serializes Microsoft Graph /me/photo/$value binary blobs to persistent Base64 Data URLs, sanitizes dead blob: URLs at the getCachedResult localStorage gate, extracts valid PictureURL from PeopleManager GetMyProperties, cascades seamlessly to canonical absoluteUrl _layouts/15/userphoto.aspx?size=L, and unifies profile harvesting across DynamicFilterWebPart and FullWidthContainerWebPart.
